svg.text: Enterprise technology capability model — what a complete IT estate has to answer for
Data Platform & Lakehouse · Data Engineering & Pipelines · Master & Reference Data Management ·
Data Governance & Catalogue · Data Quality & Lineage · Business Intelligence & Reporting · Advanced Analytics & Data Science ·
Data Contracts & Schema Management · Real-Time & Streaming Analytics
API Management · Application & Data Integration · Event Streaming & Messaging · Business Process Automation ·
Robotic Process Automation · Low-Code Application Platform · B2B & Partner Integration · Integration Operations & Observability

Directory & Identity Lifecycle · Authentication & Single Sign-On · Authorisation & Entitlements · Privileged Access Management · Identity Governance & Administration · External & Partner Identity · Customer Identity (CIAM) · Workload & Agent Identity ·
Device Provisioning & Enrolment · Configuration & Policy Management · Patch & Update Management ·
Application Packaging & Delivery · Mobile & BYOD Management · Frontline & Shared Device Management ·
Virtual Desktop & Application Access · Endpoint Analytics & Digital Experience · Device Lifecycle & Disposal
Wide Area Network & SD-WAN · Application Delivery & Protection · Remote & Hybrid Access · Secure Internet Edge ·
Network Segmentation · DNS, DHCP & Address Management · Cloud Interconnect & Peering · Network Monitoring & Assurance

Tenant & Landing Zone Architecture · Compute & Container Platform · Storage & File Services · Database Platform · Infrastructure as Code & Automation · Policy as Code & Guardrails · Backup, Recovery & Continuity · Platform Observability ·
On-Premises & Edge Infrastructure · Data Residency & Sovereign Controls

Service Desk & Request Fulfilment · Incident & Major Incident Management · Problem Management · Change & Release Management · Configuration & Asset Management · Event Monitoring & Alerting · Service Catalogue & Service Levels ·
Knowledge & Runbook Management · Capacity & Availability Management
Each capability is sized as a single product-selection decision and mapped to its Microsoft first-party answer with a coverage rating, named alternatives and a Microsoft Learn reference.
Created with the assistance of Microsoft Scout, which uses AI — verify anything you intend to rely on for a decision. Capability model and platform mapping current as at August 2026.
